units.locator: Article 1.1. Legislation on administrative offences
units.text: Article 1.1. Legislation on administrative offences
units.label: Art. 1.1

units.locator: Article 1.1. Legislation on administrative offences
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 1.1. Legislation on administrative offences
units.label: Art. 1.1

units.locator: Article 1.1. Legislation on administrative offences
units.text: 1. Legislation on administrative offences consists of this Code and the laws on administrative offences adopted by constituent entities of the Russian Federation in accordance with it.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 1.1

units.locator: Article 1.1. Legislation on administrative offences
units.text: 2. This Code is based on the Constitution of the Russian Federation, universally recognised principles and norms of international law, and international treaties of the Russian Federation. If an international treaty of the Russian Federation establishes rules other than those provided for by legislation on administrative offences, the rules of the international treaty shall apply.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 1.1

units.locator: Article 1.2. Objectives of legislation on administrative offences
units.text: Article 1.2. Objectives of legislation on administrative offences
units.label: Art. 1.2

units.locator: Article 1.2. Objectives of legislation on administrative offences
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 1.2. Objectives of legislation on administrative offences
units.label: Art. 1.2

units.locator: Article 1.2. Objectives of legislation on administrative offences
units.text: The objectives of legislation on administrative offences are to protect the individual, human and civil rights and freedoms, the health of citizens, the sanitary and epidemiological well-being of the population, public morals, the environment, the established procedure for the exercise of state power, public order and public safety, property, and the lawful economic interests of individuals and legal entities, society and the state against administrative offences, and to prevent administrative offences.
units.label: Art. 1.2 · text

units.locator: Article 1.3. Matters within the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
units.text: Article 1.3. Matters within the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
units.label: Art. 1.3

units.locator: Article 1.3. Matters within the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 1.3. Matters within the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
units.label: Art. 1.3

units.locator: Article 1.3. Matters within the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
units.text: 1. The jurisdiction of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences includes establishing:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 1.3

units.locator: Article 1.3. Matters within the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
units.text: 1) the general provisions and principles of legislation on administrative offences;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 1.3

units.locator: Article 1.3. Matters within the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
units.text: 2) the list of types of administrative penalties and the rules for their application;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 1.3

units.locator: Article 1.3. Matters within the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
units.text: 3) administrative liability in matters of federal significance, including administrative liability for breaches of rules and standards provided for by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 1.3

units.locator: Article 1.3. Matters within the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
units.text: 3.1) administrative liability for breaches of rules and standards provided for by regulatory legal acts of the public authorities of a federal territory that establish specific arrangements for regulating particular relations within the federal territory in fields defined by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, or provided for by regulatory legal acts of the public authorities of a federal territory adopted in the exercise of powers transferred to them by the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 3.1 Part 1 Art. 1.3

units.locator: Article 1.3. Matters within the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
units.text: 4) the procedure for proceedings in administrative offence cases, including the establishment of measures to secure proceedings in administrative offence cases;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 1.3

units.locator: Article 1.3. Matters within the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
units.text: 5) the procedure for enforcing rulings imposing administrative penalties.
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 1.3

units.locator: Article 1.3. Matters within the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
units.text: 2. In accordance with legislation on the judicial system, this Code determines the jurisdiction of courts over administrative offence cases.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 1.3

units.locator: Article 1.3. Matters within the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
units.text: 3. In accordance with legislation on the protection of the rights of minors, this Code determines the jurisdiction of commissions for minors' affairs and the protection of their rights over administrative offence cases.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 1.3

units.locator: Article 1.3. Matters within the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
units.text: 4. In accordance with the established structure of federal executive bodies, this Code determines the jurisdiction of federal executive bodies over cases concerning administrative offences provided for by this Code.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 1.3

units.locator: Article 1.3. Matters within the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
units.text: 5. In accordance with the objectives and functions assigned by federal laws to the state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, this Code determines the jurisdiction of executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation over cases concerning administrative offences provided for by this Code.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 1.3

units.locator: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
units.text: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
units.label: Art. 1.3.1

units.locator: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
units.label: Art. 1.3.1

units.locator: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
units.text: 1. The jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences includes:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 1.3.1

units.locator: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
units.text: 1) establishing, by the laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation on administrative offences, administrative liability for violations of laws and other regulatory legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and regulatory legal acts of local self-government bodies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 1.3.1

units.locator: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
units.text: 1.1) establishing, by the laws of the Donetsk People's Republic, the Lugansk People's Republic, Zaporozhye Oblast and Kherson Oblast on administrative offences, administrative liability for exceeding prices (tariffs) for goods and (or) maximum levels of such prices (tariffs) established by regulatory legal acts of those constituent entities of the Russian Federation, with account taken of the specific arrangements provided for by federal constitutional laws;
units.label: Point 1.1 Part 1 Art. 1.3.1

units.locator: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
units.text: 1.2) establishing, by the laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation on administrative offences, administrative liability for breaches of rules and standards provided for by regulatory legal acts of the public authorities of a federal territory, except in the cases provided for by point 3.1 of part 1 of Article 1.3 of this Code;
units.label: Point 1.2 Part 1 Art. 1.3.1

units.locator: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
units.text: 2) organising proceedings in cases concerning administrative offences provided for by the laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 1.3.1

units.locator: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
units.text: 3) determining jurisdiction over cases concerning administrative offences provided for by the laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, in accordance with part 2 of Article 22.1 of this Code;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 1.3.1

units.locator: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
units.text: 4) establishing commissions for minors' affairs and the protection of their rights;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 1.3.1

units.locator: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
units.text: 5) establishing administrative commissions and other collegiate bodies for the purpose of imposing administrative liability provided for by the laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 1.3.1

units.locator: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
units.text: 6) determining the list of officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records provided for by the laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 1.3.1

units.locator: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
units.text: 6.1) determining lists of officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records provided for by this Code, in the cases provided for by Article 28.3 of this Code;
units.label: Point 6.1 Part 1 Art. 1.3.1

units.locator: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
units.text: 7) regulating other matters by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in accordance with this Code.
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 1.3.1

units.locator: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
units.text: 2. Laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation may vest local self-government bodies with certain powers of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation to resolve the matters specified in points 4 - 6 of part 1 of this Article, with the transfer of the material and financial resources necessary for their exercise. Where a local self-government body is vested with those powers, its officials may draw up administrative offence records provided for by the laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 1.3.1

units.locator: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
units.text: 3. In the cases provided for by the laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, officials of local self-government bodies may draw up administrative offence records provided for by this Code or by the laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation when local self-government bodies exercise control (supervision) powers delegated by the Russian Federation or by constituent entities of the Russian Federation, and when exercising municipal control.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 1.3.1

units.locator: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
units.text: 4. Executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation are authorised, within the competence established by Chapter 23 of this Code, to hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by this Code.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 1.3.1

units.locator: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
units.text: 5. Officials of executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation are authorised, within the competence of the respective executive body of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, to draw up administrative offence records provided for by this Code in the cases specified in Article 28.3 of this Code.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 1.3.1

units.locator: Article 1.4. Principle of equality before the law
units.text: Article 1.4. Principle of equality before the law
units.label: Art. 1.4

units.locator: Article 1.4. Principle of equality before the law
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 1.4. Principle of equality before the law
units.label: Art. 1.4

units.locator: Article 1.4. Principle of equality before the law
units.text: 1. Persons who have committed administrative offences are equal before the law. Individuals are subject to administrative liability irrespective of sex, race, ethnicity, language, origin, property status or official position, place of residence, attitude to religion, convictions, membership of public associations or other circumstances. Legal entities are subject to administrative liability irrespective of their location, organisational and legal forms, subordination or other circumstances.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 1.4

units.locator: Article 1.4. Principle of equality before the law
units.text: 2. Special conditions for the application of measures to secure proceedings in an administrative offence case and for imposing administrative liability on officials performing certain state functions (deputies, judges, prosecutors, employees of the Investigative Committee of the Russian Federation and other persons) are established by the Constitution of the Russian Federation and federal laws.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 1.4

units.locator: Article 1.4. Principle of equality before the law
units.text: 3. Special conditions for the application of administrative liability measures in respect of non-profit organisations, as well as persons carrying on business without forming a legal entity and legal entities that are small and medium-sized enterprises, and the managers and other employees of those legal entities who have committed administrative offences in connection with the performance of organisational and managerial or administrative and economic functions (hereinafter referred to as their employees), are established by this Code.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 1.4

units.locator: Article 1.5. Presumption of innocence
units.text: Article 1.5. Presumption of innocence
units.label: Art. 1.5

units.locator: Article 1.5. Presumption of innocence
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 1.5. Presumption of innocence
units.label: Art. 1.5

units.locator: Article 1.5. Presumption of innocence
units.text: 1. A person is subject to administrative liability only for administrative offences in respect of which that person's guilt has been established.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 1.5

units.locator: Article 1.5. Presumption of innocence
units.text: 2. A person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are being conducted is presumed innocent until that person's guilt has been proved in accordance with the procedure provided for by this Code and established by a ruling that has entered into legal force, issued by the judge, body or official that heard the case.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 1.5

units.locator: Article 1.5. Presumption of innocence
units.text: 3. A person being held administratively liable is not obliged to prove their innocence, except in the cases provided for by the note to this Article.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 1.5

units.locator: Article 1.5. Presumption of innocence
units.text: 4. Irremovable doubts as to the guilt of a person being held administratively liable shall be interpreted in that person's favour.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 1.5

units.locator: Article 1.5. Presumption of innocence
units.text: Note. The provision of part 3 of this Article does not apply to administrative offences provided for by parts 3.1 - 3.4 of Article 8.2 and Chapter 12 of this Code, or to administrative offences in the field of territorial improvement and administrative offences consisting in failure to comply with the procedure for paying for the passage of a vehicle along toll public motor roads of regional, intermunicipal and local significance, private public motor roads, toll sections of public motor roads of regional, intermunicipal and local significance, and toll sections of private public motor roads, as provided for by the laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, committed with the use of vehicles or by the owner or possessor of a land plot or other immovable property, where those administrative offences are recorded by special technical devices operating in automatic mode and having photographic, cinematographic or video-recording functions, or by photographic, cinematographic or video-recording equipment; nor does it apply to administrative offences provided for by parts 6 - 8 of Article 14.3.1, parts 4 - 6 of Article 14.6, part 4 of Article 14.43 and Article 15.12.2 of this Code where those administrative offences are recorded using the state information system for monitoring the circulation of goods subject to mandatory marking with means of identification.
units.label: Art. 1.5 · “Note. The provision of part 3 of this Article does not apply to…”
